Atlantis NDT — Non-Destructive Testing Services, Training, Consulting & Software

Atlantis NDT is a global non-destructive testing company delivering inspection services, NDT training and certification, ASNT Level III consulting, and purpose-built inspection software. Founded by Anoop Rayavarapu — an ASNT NDT Level III in multiple methods and API 653 Authorized Inspector — the company operates from Houston, Texas and Hyderabad, India, and serves clients across the USA, India, the UAE, Saudi Arabia, Singapore, and worldwide. Our team of 50+ certified ASNT Level III specialists covers ultrasonic, radiographic, magnetic particle, penetrant, eddy current, and visual testing for oil & gas, aerospace, marine, nuclear, power generation, and manufacturing clients.

Four Product Segments

NDT Training & Certification — Level I, II, and III courses per ASNT SNT-TC-1A and ISO 9712 across UT, RT, MT, PT, ET, VT and advanced methods (PAUT, TOFD), plus ASNT certification preparation and API 510, API 570, and API 653 inspector exam prep. Instructor-led classes in Houston, Hyderabad, Dubai, and online — with a 96% first-attempt pass rate.

ASNT Level III Consulting — outsourced Level III services, written practice development, procedure development and qualification, API RBI program design, fitness-for-service per API 579, and code compliance across ASME, API, AWS, ISO, and EN standards.

Atlantis ERP — affordable, fully customizable NDT inspection management software built on 30+ integrated business apps: work orders, technician certification tracking, calibration management, quoting, invoicing, and NDT reporting software that turns field data into client-ready reports.

Digital Twins — an enterprise digital twin platform for asset integrity: 3D asset visualization, defect mapping, corrosion overlay, predictive analytics, and turnaround planning, delivered via web or VR/AR.

Inspection Services, 3D Scanning & NDT Connect

Beyond software and training, Atlantis NDT delivers field inspection services — corrosion mapping, phased array UT, tank floor MFL, and API 510/570/653 driven inspection programs — plus 3D laser scanning services using LiDAR, photogrammetry, and drone capture to build accurate as-built models of plants, tanks, and structures. Our NDT Connect marketplace links qualified inspectors with companies that need certified personnel, and our free resources library offers checklists, templates, and study guides authored by Level III professionals.

With offices in Houston and Hyderabad and delivery capability across the United States, India, the UAE, Saudi Arabia, Qatar, Singapore, Malaysia, Australia, the UK, and beyond, Atlantis NDT has completed 1,000+ inspections and trained thousands of technicians.
